sourceFile: 62. BRS-201506 Report checking dimension AAP and AWF JIG date 12.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable AWF-to-AAP jig change evidence but misstates the changed factor and misgroups measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor uses filename instead of AWF JIG to AAP JIG.
Baseline and changed conditions are incorrectly marked not explicit.
Outcome stats mix headers, positions, samples, and GAP rows.
Key evidence row for after-change condition is missing from factor citations.
Spec and violation interpretation are unreliable.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to jig change from AWF JIG baseline to AAP JIG changed condition.
Cite header/spec rows plus AWF, after-change, GAP, and decision rows.
Separate JIG dimension results from COIL length/width results under the same change context.
Rebuild metrics by length, width, position, sample, and spec range without mixing GAP values.
Reassess judgement only from corrected grouped measurements and decision text.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations exist but are not sufficient for final evidence; add direct condition and result rows.
